notes.title: Update 1 (Version 0.531)
notes.content: [h1]Update 1 (Version 0.531)[/h1][h2]Nunchaku, Traffic Lights and Tesla Coils[/h2][p][/p][h3]New Unlockable Modifiers[/h3][p]-Traffic Light (Interactive Element)[/p][p]-Nunchaku (Weapon)[/p][p]-Tesla Coil (Interactive Element)[/p][p][/p][h3]New Features[/h3][p]-Dropped Weapon are pickable[/p][p]-Particles effects limited by FPS[/p][p]-New Graphical Effects[/p][p]-New Secondary Boomerang Attack[/p][p]-All the weapon can activate Hives and Fire Trap[/p][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes (Main)[/h3][p]-No more than one weapon held[/p][p]-No more no weapon[/p][p]-Reduced the range of Dynamite[/p][p]-Other minor bugs \[...][/p][p][/p]
